## Test Coverage Checklist

- [ ] I added or updated tests for this change (unit/integration/regression/e2e where relevant).
- [ ] If this fixes a bug, I added a regression test.
- [ ] I ran `npm run test` locally.
- [ ] For major, non-cosmetic changes (new feature, data flow, auth, API), I ran `npm run verify:full`.
